title: How the GString headers are checked

entities.title: The headers are well-formed C++
entities.summary: all.hpp, and so every header, compiles as C++98 and as C++17, with GCC and with Clang, when GSTRING_SYNTAX_CHECK is defined.
criteria: With -DGSTRING_SYNTAX_CHECK -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -fsyntax-only, including gstring/all.hpp gives no error and no warning under -std=c++98 and -std=c++17.
This holds for GCC and for Clang.
Passing says the declarations are well-formed, and nothing more: nothing is defined, so nothing links or runs.

checks.description: Run from the repository root; repeat with -std=c++17, and with clang++ in place of g++. No workflow runs it: the repository has no CI.
